arguments.sql:
WITH labels AS (
    SELECT 'Patient' AS source, Diagnosis, Birthday FROM main.Patient
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Examination', Diagnosis, NULL FROM main.Examination
)
SELECT source, Diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS records, MIN(Birthday), MAX(Birthday)
FROM labels
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%psor%' OR Diagnosis LIKE '%psa%' OR Diagnosis LIKE '%arthrit%'
GROUP BY source, Diagnosis
